MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone fit the same listening and calling purpose as my earlier headset, so they are plausible if I need a replacement.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender connects loosely to my history of networking accessories, although that connection alone does not give me a reason to buy it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers, streaming players and a smart plug do not solve the computer connection or accessory needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "My tablet mount purchase suggests a need to support a tablet I already use, not a need to buy another tablet.",
    "The memory card and Wi-Fi extender require specific storage or coverage needs that I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronics generally, including entertainment and home automation devices.",
    "My networking purchases seem to have been treated as interchangeable, even though adding Ethernet connectivity and extending Wi-Fi coverage solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases point toward practical accessories with particular connections and uses; compatibility and the problem each item solves matter to me.",
    "I interact infrequently and need a concrete reason to buy, so even related earbuds are only appealing when my existing audio equipment needs replacing.",
    "My latest purchase addressed wired network connectivity, which does not establish a need for better wireless coverage."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but mostly missed the specific, practical needs behind my accessory purchases."
}
